intent_contract.text: 시각 의미 데이터와 후보팩에 반영해줘. 그 다음 독립된 서브에이전트 3개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.

Create one independently randomized, materially complex photographic test case using the supplied portrait only for visible adult appearance, then make the assigned smartphone-scale perspective relationship unmistakably judgeable in the rendered pixels.

Create a single vertical social editorial photograph inside a heat-warped underground film-computation vault during an emergency archive salvage. Use the supplied portrait solely as a visible adult appearance reference: one visibly adult woman with long dark wavy hair, brown eyes, a neutral expression, a black blouse, and a small gold necklace. She salvages the final climate-model tape by bracing at a central recovery console while pulling a continuous translucent punched-film strip out of an oxidized brass logic wheel inches from the camera; the strip crosses her hands, threads through flooded calculation machinery, and reaches a blinking cold-storage tower deep in the vault. A very broad field of view spans the wheel, both side aisles, the centered console, and the remote tower in one rectilinear exposure. The near foreground appears relatively enlarged, with the brass wheel dominating the lower corner while the woman remains fully readable at mid-distance and the tower is tiny but distinct. Stretching increases toward the outer edges across the wheel rim, acetate strips, and side machinery, while her upright figure forms a stable central perspective anchor with straight central verticals. The phone-close camera position begins beside the wheel, and the unspooling tape creates a continuous foreground-to-distance action path. Green emergency strips cut through low sea mist, glinting on warped acetate, oxidized brass, and shallow water. Preserve realistic smartphone optics, tactile deterioration, documentary skin and fabric texture, and a coherent single-frame physical event.
